stops.caption: Projects, writing and code are on the monitor. The NAS next to it runs my film library.
San Francisco and Delhi: where I live and where I grew up. The mango on the sill is for the one I planted in Delhi as a kid.
The Voyager Golden Record and the Pale Blue Dot. Each opens what I wrote about it.
My favourite books: Murakami, Yoshimoto, Vuong and Greene.
The espresso machine pulls a shot when you click it. The oven opens on my recipes.
Photos from my film and digital cameras.
My four favourite films on Letterboxd. Click the lava lamp under them to change its colour.
Pick a record from the crate and it plays instead of the room's music.
